### Issue description

If I make the editor window full-screen (via Shift+F11), close the editor and reopen my project then the editor window is no longer full-screen.

### Steps to reproduce

- Open a project to bring up the editor
- Press Shift+F11 in order to make the editor window full-screen
- Close the editor window (Alt+f4 or Ctrl+Q)
- Re-open the project and note that the editor window is not full-screen
